results.title: Write, edit and delete a note
results.checks: Select 3:16 → Note → type → Save → it is listed under John 3:16; its ⋮ → Edit changes it; ⋮ → Delete asks 'Delete annotation?' and removes it
results.note: created, edited, deleted; the pane counts 0 notes

results.title: The phone's verse sheet
results.checks: On an iPhone 13, tapping John 3:3 brings up the old reader's sheet along the bottom in place of the tabs: a handle, ✕, 'John 3:3' and four cards Highlight · Save · Note · Copy, with 'Swipe up to see more'. A tap on the handle shows Share and Compare; a swipe down closes the sheet and the tabs come back. Highlight turns it into the colour strip with ← and the eraser; a colour highlights the verse and closes the sheet
results.note: cards Highlight · Save · Note · Copy in place of the tabs; the handle showed Share and Compare; a swipe down closed it; Highlight → the strip with ← and the eraser; a colour highlighted 3:3

results.title: Notes as the old reader shows them
results.checks: With no notes, the Notes pane says 'You don't have any notes for this chapter.' with Create a note; with nothing chosen it writes a note on the whole chapter (grouped as John 3, 'Annotation saved'); a note on 3:16 groups under John 3:16 with 'You' and when; a group folds; while a draft is open, choosing 3:17–18 moves it there
results.note: empty state, a whole-chapter note, a grouped verse note with You and when, folding, and the draft following 3:17–18

results.title: A note when the editor cannot load
results.checks: With the rich editor's file blocked, Note opens a plain text box that says so; the note saved from it is listed
results.note: the plain box took the note and it was listed

results.title: The verse sheet shows the chosen verses' notes
results.checks: With a note on John 3:16, a phone's verse sheet for 3:16, pulled up, shows the note under 'John 3:16' with ⋮ Edit and Delete; Delete asks 'Delete annotation?' and the note goes
results.note: the sheet showed the note under John 3:16 with Edit and Delete; Delete asked and removed it
